name: starflask_generate_3d
description: Create a Starflask 3D mesh generation job (text-to-3D or image-to-3D). Returns a job id immediately — poll with starflask_get_job until status is 'completed', then read result.model_url (the generated 3D model) and result.thumbnail_url. Pass the request as the `payload` object using the structured form: {"structured_data": {"model_key": "<key>", "params": {...}}}. Text-to-3D params: {"prompt": "a low-poly treasure chest", "topology": "triangle", "target_polycount": 30000, "enable_pbr": true}. Image-to-3D: pass {"image_url": "<url from starflask_upload_media>"} instead of (or with) prompt. NOTE: the job type is "mesh" — this tool sends it for you. Use starflask_list_models to see available mesh model keys (e.g. meshy-v6) and their input_schema.

payload.description: The 3D generation request, e.g. {"structured_data": {"model_key": "meshy-v6", "params": {"prompt": "...", "topology": "triangle", "target_polycount": 30000, "enable_pbr": true}}}. For image-to-3D, use params {"image_url": "..."}.
